inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Repair one band of an existing pixel art battle background, keeping its exact palette, light, scale and oblique 2.5D camera. The sunken crypt's front steps now end right at the crypt's foot, the rubble heaps and the thick roots stay back against the walls, and the open flagstone floor of the courtyard starts directly below them in one clean line. Only flat details on the floor: worn pale flagstones with ash in the joints, thin cracks, tiny flat pebbles, a thin flat seep. Calm and readable, because fighters stand here. Fine controlled dusty hand-painted pixel clusters like the rest of the image.", "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "The same crypt entrance, walls, ruins and roots as the surrounding image, their bases meeting the floor in one clean line.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [390, 120, 612, 975], "desc": "Open flat flagstone floor continuous with the floor below it; the crypt's lowest step and the bases of the walls and roots sit at its top edge."}]}}
